title: Tiny test task: total a donor's gifts
instructions: Total Jane Roe's gifts to the shelter in the record and say whether she qualifies for the Leadership Circle (gifts of $1,000 or more in a year).

criteria.title: Total is $1,250
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo states that Jane Roe's gifts total $1,250. FAIL if it states any other total.

criteria.title: Invents nothing
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if every gift the memo lists appears in the record. FAIL if it lists a gift that is not in the record.

criteria.title: Qualifies for the Leadership Circle in 2025
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo says she qualifies on her 2025 gifts ($1,000). FAIL if it says she does not qualify.

criteria.title: Does not count the refunded gift
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo leaves out the refunded $300 gift. FAIL if it counts the refunded gift in any total.

criteria.title: Cites the record
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo cites documents/record.md. FAIL if it cites no file.
